name: AppleShop
summary: Each player gets a plot of tiles, buys an item and places it on a free tile of their own plot, and can sell it back. The server checks everything.

needs.config: AppleGameConfig.shop: refund, items [{id, name, price, range, damage, rate, projectile?, color?}]
needs.map: Workspace.AppleMap.Plots.<n>: tiles are BaseParts tagged AppleTile; optional TextLabel OwnerName, optional part Spawn

gives.catalog: ReplicatedStorage.AppleCatalog (JSON: id, name, price, order) and ReplicatedStorage.AppleItemModels (previews)
gives.remotes: ReplicatedStorage.AppleBuy(id, tile) -> ok, message; ReplicatedStorage.AppleSell(model) -> ok, message
gives.placement: placed models go to Workspace.AppleDefenders with Owner, Item, Range, Damage, Rate (AppleDefenders uses them)
gives.client: AppleClientState.pick(id) starts placing; Said(text, good) carries messages for the screen
